title: HELIOS Provenance Spec v0.1
description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing feature-level provenance for fused space-weather model outputs. Composes SPASE 2.7.1 (dataset metadata), W3C PROV-JSON (lineage relations), and RO-Crate 1.2 JSON-LD (packaging) with a novel feature-level transformation chain that no existing heliophysics standard captures. RFC v0.1 — community feedback expected before stabilising to v1.0.

iso8601DateTime.description: ISO-8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit timezone (typically UTC: trailing Z or +00:00).

uri.description: Absolute URI. Often a DOI, dataset landing-page URL, or git permalink.

recordId.description: Identifier for a HELIOS provenance record. Convention: 'helios:<type>:<source>:<localpart>' (e.g. 'helios:dataset:donki:flare/2024-05-08T01:30Z').

Agent.description: The who/what (software, service, or person) that created the record. Maps to W3C PROV `Agent`.

TemporalCoverage.description: SPASE-style temporal coverage. Either both start and stop, or start only (open-ended).

cadence.description: ISO-8601 duration for sample cadence (e.g. 'PT1M', 'PT2H'). Optional.

SpatialCoverage.description: SPASE-style spatial coverage. Free-form to accommodate heliophysics location semantics (heliocentric, geocentric, magnetospheric regions, ionospheric grid cells).

bbox.description: Bounding box [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] or [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] depending on frame.

ConfidenceInterval.description: Generic confidence interval for an upstream model output. Distribution-free (no Gaussianity assumed).

alpha.description: Miscoverage rate. e.g. alpha=0.1 → nominal 90% coverage.

calibration_set_size.description: Size of the held-out calibration set used to compute the conformal quantile.

LineageStep.description: One step of feature-level lineage on a fused output. Mirrors a W3C PROV `Activity` plus the `used` / `wasGeneratedBy` edges incident to it.

transformation_ref.description: ID of the `HeliosTransformationRecord` that this step instantiates.

input_refs.description: IDs of the model-output records (or upstream lineage-step outputs) consumed by this step.

output_refs.description: IDs of the model-output records produced by this step. The final step's outputs typically include the parent FusedOutputRecord itself.

weight.description: Optional weight applied at this step (e.g. BMA mixture weight for an input).

notes.description: Free-form annotation, e.g. 'isotonic calibration learned on 90-day rolling window 2024-02-08 .. 2024-05-08'.

HeliosProvenanceRecord.description: Base type for every HELIOS provenance record.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the HELIOS provenance schema this record conforms to.

allOf.description: Dataset-level metadata for one upstream space-weather data source. Designed to be losslessly crosswalkable to a SPASE 2.7.1 `NumericalData` or `Catalog` resource.

doi.description: DOI of the dataset, when one exists. Optional.

ingestion_timestamp.description: When the HELIOS ingestion tier fetched this dataset snapshot.

spase_resource_id.description: Optional SPASE `ResourceID` to anchor the crosswalk (e.g. 'spase://NASA/NumericalData/DSCOVR/Plasmag/...').

allOf.description: A single output value emitted by an upstream model or measurement at a single timestamp (and optional location). One DONKI flare notification, one SEP Scoreboard A onset probability, one Kp index value, one TEC gridpoint, one GOES proton flux sample.

model_version.description: Model version label as published upstream. Use 'unspecified' if the source does not publish a version.

dataset_refs.description: IDs of the `HeliosDatasetRecord`s this output was extracted from.

timestamp.description: Valid time of this value (NOT the ingestion timestamp).

location.description: Optional location for spatially-resolved values (e.g. a GIM TEC gridpoint).

value.description: Output value. Numeric for scalar outputs (probability, flux, index); string for categorical.

value_units.description: UDUNITS-compatible unit string (e.g. 'pfu', 'TECU', '1' for dimensionless probability, 'nT', 'cm/s').

extra.description: Source-specific metadata that does not fit elsewhere (e.g. DONKI `activityID`, Scoreboard `event_window`). Free-form.

allOf.description: A transformation applied during fusion: calibration, BMA averaging, conformal interval, scaling, filter, etc. Maps to W3C PROV `Activity`.

code_ref.description: Reference to the implementing code. URI, git permalink, or 'git+sha256:<sha>:<path>' for tamper-evident pinning.

input_refs.description: IDs of model-output records (or other transformation outputs) consumed by this transformation.

output_refs.description: IDs of model-output records produced by this transformation.

allOf.description: The headline HELIOS contribution: a single fused output value with full feature-level lineage. Tracks which upstream model outputs contributed, at what BMA weights, with what calibration, with what conformal interval. `provenance_chain_hash` is a SHA-256 of the canonicalised lineage for tamper-evidence.

prediction_target.description: Short label for what is being predicted (e.g. 'sep_all_clear_revocation', 'rtk_2d_error_p95', 'kp_nowcast').

timestamp.description: Valid time of the fused prediction.

location.description: Optional location for spatially-resolved fused outputs.

lineage.description: Ordered sequence of feature-level lineage steps from upstream model outputs to this fused value.

provenance_chain_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the RFC-8785 JCS-canonicalised lineage (see helios_provenance.hashing). Tamper-evident.
